name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v538: Cloudflare bypass actually shows and saves cookies. (1) probeAndResolveIfNeeded now ACTUALLY SHOWS the bypass WebView when Cloudflare is detected - previously it just returned true without opening anything, so no Cloudflare box appeared and no cookies were saved. (2) currentActivity() restores the foreground Activity lookup so the bypass dialog can be displayed from anywhere during playback. (3) CineStream.load() stores context in CineStreamExtractors.context so the bypass can find the Activity. (4) Invisible WebView uses CloudStream's proven alpha=0 attach pattern - no challenge page overlaps the CineAnime home on TV. (5) isUsableClearance accepts existing cf_clearance once page loads past challenge - cookies actually save. (6) Poll timeout 30s - fail fast. (7) Same cleaned UA in both WebView paths. (8) WebView settings restored for Cloudflare Turnstile. (9) Always require cf_clearance before marking solve successful. (10) Removed dead JS cookie probe. (11) Clear in-flight bypass on dismiss. (12) Background API config load. (13) Clear all cookies deletes Domain=.host jar variants.
